Opening Suleyman's own launch essay on Greylock.I found one 2022 prediction that fits all four rules. Suleyman's two main public statements that year contain no other dated claims.

- **The one prediction (20 January 2022):** On Greylock's Greymatter podcast, when he joined the firm, Suleyman said that "at least in five years time" transformers and foundation models (large AI models trained on broad data) would be "completely ubiquitous". I read this on Greylock's own transcript of the episode. That page shows the sentence as a highlighted pull-quote at the start of his answer, so it may be slightly trimmed from the audio. I did not check it against the recording.
- **Inflection launch essay (8 March 2022):** He said machines "will soon" understand our language. This has no date, and it isn't about when AGI or superintelligence arrives, so I left it out under your rules.
- **TechCrunch profile (20 January 2022):** It reports his outlook on AI, medical imaging and the metaverse, with no year or span attached.

- The glasp.co copy of the Greymatter transcript would not open.
- My first try at the Greylock transcript was rejected because that link had not yet appeared in a search result. The second try, after a search returned it, worked.
- There was a 13th search for other 2022 interviews, which the system blocked because the limit was reached. It is not in the log.
- I did not look at his November 2022 X post or his 2022 conference talks.

Several later dated predictions came up in search results, but I saw them only in snippets and did not open them. They are listed under other_years.
